verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents worldwide VAT/GST calculation, monitoring of potential registration obligations and registration support. However, documented filing automation covers only US sales tax (via TaxJar), and community reports say UK/EU remittance and filing are left to the user. Missing for 10: explicit EU OSS/IOSS support, named coverage of the UK, Canada and Australia, documented foreign threshold tracking beyond generic monitoring, and international VAT/GST filing support.

support.subject: As a founder selling internationally, VAT and GST are covered like US sales tax — EU OSS/IOSS, UK, Canada, Australia and beyond, with foreign registration thresholds tracked and filings supported

citations.quote: Calculate sales tax, VAT, and GST for transactions worldwide, determining tax rates based on product type, customer location, and business location.
Stripe Tax provides insights about your potential tax registration obligations (called economic nexus in the US).
You can also use Stripe to register on your behalf.
Stripe Tax integrates with TaxJar to automate filing for US sales tax
